exposure: Non-eclamptic hypertensive disorders of pregnancy (HDP)-related severe maternal morbidity (SMM)
outcome: Quality of management for women with eclampsia (antenatal care, pre-eclampsia care, eclampsia care)
cohort: The study included 51 women with eclampsia, 351 women with non-eclamptic HDP-related severe maternal morbidity (SMM), and 3,651 control women without SMM, drawn from 182,309 maternities.
finding: Antenatal care for women with eclampsia was considered inadequate or substandard in 39%, pre-eclampsia care in 76%, and eclampsia care in 50% (primarily due to inadequate use of magnesium sulphate), highlighting a high proportion of inadequate quality of care.
